verdict.rationale: Tavily ships an official MCP server that exposes tavily-search and tavily-extract as ready-made tools for Cursor, Claude Desktop and any MCP client. It also offers a coding-agent setup skill and LLM-oriented SDK helpers such as get_search_context and qna_search, which return output meant to go straight to an LLM or RAG pipeline. However, the evidence shows no published function-calling JSON schemas, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Missing for 10: explicit function-calling/tool schemas, documented agent-framework integrations (e.g. LangChain, LlamaIndex or OpenAI tools), and independent hands-on corroboration of agent tool use.
